qualification: Source age overlaps acquisition/mapping/publication: do not add it to worker time.
compute_seconds includes self-filtering/extraction; worker_seconds includes transport.
planner_plus_research_sampling_seconds includes dense SDK target sampling for independent veto. Internal phase timers are production planner measurements.
Instrumented Kit gap and request-to-command include both source plans and separate GT physical-veto waits; these are not production-only latency.
GPU rendering time and native RRT internal collision-query counts are not exposed by these measurements.
Execution control timing exists only for executed motions.
